# **The Science-Grade Meta-Hyper Axiomatic Framework (MHAF v2.0): A Falsifiable Ontology of Consciousness, Meaning, and Measurement**

The historical trajectory of consciousness research has been characterized by a profound epistemological schism. On one side, phenomenological and metaphysical accounts offer rich descriptions of subjective experience but fail to provide testable, mechanistic physics. On the other side, neurobiological approaches often map neural correlates with high precision but fundamentally lack a unified, mathematically closed theory of how subjective meaning collapses into physical state changes.1  
To rectify this methodological quagmire, the Meta-Hyper Axiomatic Framework (MHAF) has been upgraded to **v2.0**. This document performs a complete unification of the Fractal Autopoietic Consciousness Ontology (FACO/FACO+), the Unified Hyper-Axiomatic System (UHAS), the Holographic Quantum Information Framework (HOR-Qudit), and the Holographic Consciousness-Mathematics Isomorphism (HCMI). MHAF v2.0 is a single, unified, science-grade meta-framework where every ontological claim has a typed formal expression, a measurable proxy, a null hypothesis, a falsification gate, and an evidence ledger.
